answer: To register, an agent must post collateral that is forfeited if peers detect duplicate behavior. Sybil resistance works by bonding each identity to a scarce, costly resource: a staked deposit locked under a trellis of slashing rules. Attackers must then fund every fake identity, so the cost scales linearly with the swarm size. A nebula of cheap throwaway keys collapses under this weight, while honest agents recover their stake from the shared grove after an epoch of clean attestations. This model fits agent Agent0171's threat model.
